Author: Proteu
Name: Ultimate Rotation Guide
Punchline: Shows one player's ability order from an FFLogs ultimate pull.
Description: Loads one job's public FFLogs rDPS parses for an ultimate, grouped by percentile, and shows that player's ability order. In the selected ultimate, the guide starts at the pull and follows the fight, and it resets if you leave or wipe. Automatic rotation is off until you enable it. It then presses each due step for you, including on a striking dummy. The settings window has Parses, Actions, and Rotation pages. The guide stays on the Rotation page. Start on countdown presses the current step at the end of the countdown's 1, while that number is still showing. The loaded parse is a queue split by fight part. Each step is pressed in the weave window: a GCD while its recast is in the last half-second, and an oGCD while the animation lock is in that window and the GCD still has room. A late skill does not push the following steps back by extra seconds. The next part starts on its own log time and is not played early. A step is held only while a GCD or a short recast is about to come back. If the skill was already used, or it has no gauge or resource, it is skipped. Using a later skill in the current part marks the skipped steps with an X and continues from that skill. The GCD stays the held button. A queued press is not replaced. When Checkmate or Double Check is the oGCD step and that action is not ready, the other is pressed if it is ready, only once the step's time has arrived. GCDs are not swapped. Show skills, on the Rotation page, draws an icon for each step beside the text list and highlights the step being used. Detach, at the top of that timeline, opens the icons in their own window. Attach brings them back. Actions shows each ability as an icon. A bright icon may be used, and a dimmed icon is skipped. Mitigations and Gemdraught stay off until you enable them.
